qreB02SportingSide.why: a measured distance with no duration cannot be checked against the plausibility window; UNKNOWN DURATION_REQUIRED with an ask, never pace evidence or history reference; UNKNOWN does not count for X-2 (r3a WE3A-03); without the reference L30 changes only the expression (WE3A-07); the native session stays partial (the step holds); in the differential 1,736 untimed cases change and none gains credit, pace evidence or a larger reference

newFindings.what: With the import first, the symptom stop exists only as a RUN_REPORT_RECEIVED fact in runFormatRecord. Facts dropped by the client, or a damaged fact row (only named in unreadableReports), lose the stop: screen not raised and 6 native sessions. The engine's conflicted row does not reference the quarantined report. A missing cited format gives HOLD; an unreadable safety fact fails open.
newFindings.closesWith: An unreadable report fact fails closed (runs by time, or HOLD as for a lost format), and the integration keeps the facts with the engine record under the keyed chain in one commit (Security A-01/A-06), as safety data.

newFindings.what: A screen stamped later the same day than the review that brings the stop (assessedAt 21:00, review 20:00) is accepted by the engine as current (it checks the date) and taken by the extension as answered after the stop: 7 native at once. Date-only same day, or an earlier instant, keeps the screen required; a next-day date makes the engine ASK.
newFindings.closesWith: The instant of the screen that clears a stop may not be later than the review's own instant (or the custody stamps it).

newFindings.when: Product, before real-athlete use; extends QRE-RWS-A-07
newFindings.what: Under an eligibility ASK runFormat.prescribing is false but each TIME session keeps prescribed true. Unassessed eligibility is no permission to prescribe (SSCTR-05); a consumer reading only the session flag would offer training.
newFindings.closesWith: A session under prescribing false (ASK) is not offered as training to do until the screen is answered, as already holds for prescribed false.

newFindings.what: A run report outside the plan (no sessionId) that declares a symptom stop is stored by the engine as UNPLANNED and its stop is never read: screen not raised, 11 native. The ADF contract today defines loose runs only as imports, which carry no stop, so it does not block.
newFindings.closesWith: The app never offers a stop reason on a run outside the plan, or the stop on such a row is read for the screen like any other.

newFindings.what: A REVIEW_BEFORE_THE_RECORD answer on a decision the engine accepted names only a stop in the request itself, not one the record already holds (a fact kept by an unknown-format ASK, then a review queued earlier): screen null, 0 extension sessions. No native session is delivered by that inert answer, the fact stays on record and the next accepted review is REQUIRED with 0 native. Under the custody asOf is the server clock, so the path needs a clock that goes back.
newFindings.closesWith: Every inert answer on an accepted decision names the screen the record requires (and, on the QRE side, carries the calibration over the admitted record).

newFindings.when: condition of the enabling record; gates integration
newFindings.what: Under the custody (src/boundary/custody.mjs) the app report and the import of one run in two requests fail closed in both orders: the second request returns ok:false, nothing is kept, the answer carries only ok and error. Import first: the symptom stop is nowhere and no screen reaches the app. In one request the stored row is conflicted without the stop and the custody keeps no runFormatRecord, so the fact is lost too. The custody runs the frozen v1-index by default, delivers no native session today, and the composed entry point is not integrated: not blocking for the synthetic candidate.
newFindings.closesWith: The composed entry point with V1X-RUN-NATIVE on enters no custody or integration until the custody accepts the engine merge and conflict mark on a stored row, keeps facts and formats in the same sealed commit, and the answer carries the required screen; test in both orders with the stop.

newFindings.what: The merge sums the import's distance and the app's segments. An app that also lists the recording the import brought double-counts: 26 km on a 16 km target, MEASURED, history reference 26, CT-3 ceiling 18.084 to 28.6. The same fault in one report gives the same result, so it is not the merge's. Never pace evidence; the next long run stays 16 km (the dose is by time).
newFindings.closesWith: Data contract: each recording in one report only (dedupe by activity id), with SSCTR-RWS-B-03.

newFindings.what: A refused review (integrity HOLD, invalid input, earlier than the record) keeps nothing; the engine does not record the report either. The stop is named only in the answer.
newFindings.closesWith: The client shows the named screen and sends the report again, as for any refused report.
